m: Cook the rice. Herb butter: soften the butter and mash in lime zest, chopped coriander and a pinch of salt.
Char the corn cobs directly over a gas flame, on a BBQ or in a dry pan until blackened in spots. Slice the kernels off.
Salad: corn, diced avocado, tomatoes and red onion with lime juice, paprika, oil and salt.
Pat the fish skin bone dry and salt it. Heat a pan with oil until shimmering and lay the fish in skin side down, pressing with a spatula for 30 seconds so it stays flat.
Cook 4 to 5 minutes without moving until the skin is crisp and the flesh is mostly opaque, then flip for 1 minute.
Serve skin side up with a knob of herb butter melting on top, the corn salad and rice.
l: Pack the fish over rice with the salad on the side. Eat within a day.
